history.content: Hi, my phone isn't getting any signal at all. I can't make calls or use the internet.

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. Your line status is currently active, so let’s proceed with troubleshooting your phone’s signal issue.

To help you further, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If you see an airplane mode icon (✈️)
- What the signal strength indicator shows (bars, “No Signal”, etc.)
- If any network type (5G, 4G, etc.) is displayed

This will help determine the next steps. If you need instructions on how to check, let me know!
I see a 'No Signal' icon and 'Data Disabled' in the status bar. There’s no airplane mode icon, and I’m connected to WiFi (Chestnut-5G).

Thank you for the details. Since you see “No Signal” and “Data Disabled,” but airplane mode is not on, let’s check for possible SIM card issues and network settings.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? Look for any messages like:
- SIM missing
- SIM locked
- SIM active

Let me know what it says, and we’ll continue troubleshooting from there. If you need help finding this information, just ask!
It says my SIM is locked.

Your SIM card is locked, which is why you’re unable to get any signal or use mobile data. Unlocking a SIM typically requires entering a PIN or PUK code, and for security reasons, I am unable to assist with unlocking SIM cards directly.

You will need to contact technical support or visit your carrier’s store to unlock your SIM. If you would like, I can transfer you to a human agent who can assist you further with unlocking your SIM card.

Would you like me to transfer you now?
